claim: They [the Democrats] want to ... ban fracking.
justification: High-confidence evidence shows that the 2020 Democratic Party platform did not call for a nationwide ban on fracking (confidence 0.85), and Joe Biden, the Democratic nominee, explicitly stated he would not ban fracking, focusing only on new permits on federal lands (confidence 0.90). While some individual Democratic members advocated for a ban, this was not the official party position, refuting the claim that Democrats as a whole want to ban fracking.
